name: finite-gradient-and-adam-state-hold
operation: For 900 future optimizer occurrences, set each current parameter gradient to None before AdamW. This skips parameter writes, Adam per-parameter step, exp_avg, exp_avg_sq and decoupled weight decay. A learning-rate-zero fallback is restored after each occurrence if native parameters are unavailable.

predicted_mechanism_state_change.adam_second_moment_reserve: held constant when native parameters are exposed
predicted_mechanism_state_change.renewal_phase: held constant and resumed after release

stability_effect_rationale: The graph uses a repeated full batch and exposes no operative stochastic layer source. With parameter versions and all per-parameter Adam states skipped together, the post-release mechanism resumes from the same state; renewal shocks and recoveries translate with formation rather than changing their state-relative severity.

frozen: current parameter gradients before optimizer use
intervention_state_audit.why_continuing_state_is_nonoperative: Every observed training batch has the same content hashes and membership, and layer-forward facts expose no stochastic input; the external occurrence number is not an optimizer source—the per-parameter step object is, and it is skipped when grad is None.
